text: Free demo: you drive your own survival train through a wasteland of sandstorms.
And you're hunting the Psycho Doctor who made you.
Rusty guns, a buzzsaw for close range, and mutants everywhere.
Best moment in the trailer: a giant mechanical scorpion with glowing eyes, down in the caves.
You can smash crates and traps along the way too.
The catch? The hits feel light, and the blood splatter looks like a sticker on the screen.
The Windows demo is almost six gigs, in thirteen languages.
Worth a dip if you like your horror rusty.
